Suppinger single-cell biological interpretation

Source: vignettes/suppinger_biological_interpretation.qmd

Suppinger study biological description of cell types

The Suppinger dataset annotates gastruloid single cells into developmental families spanning pluripotent and epiblast states, gastrulation-associated progenitors, mesodermal and somitic lineages, definitive endoderm, and rare culture-associated artefacts. Table 1 summarises each annotated state and its main biological interpretation in the gastruloid context.
